text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Oguri, happy birthday to ya~! We're 
having a party once we get back to the 
dorms~."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, calling it a party's a bit rich when 
we've got zero budget. So this time, we're 
doing it Tamamo-family style!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Frugal and thrifty! Cut and paint flyers 
for decorations, and for meals, throw 
together the day's cheapest picks. Well, 
ain't that exciting~?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm really... looking forward to it. 
It makes me so happy...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Listen, I'm tellin' ya it ain't 
luxurious. Honestly, my plan was just to 
stuff your belly with rice instead of side 
dishes. Why're ya happy about that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is it because... Tama always decides 
everything for me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? Still as spacey as ever, huh~ So if 
I told ya "No food on your birthday!", 
you'd still be all happy about it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?! Th-That's... ugh, but... Tama 
knows me better than I know myself. If 
skipping a meal is Tama's way of 
celebrating... then I'll... gladly accept!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Dummy, I was obviously joking! Sheesh, 
you really need some fish to smarten up. 
Maybe I should go buy some eel too...
